- [RARC.5.2.6] **Slot typing, on every path.** No fact enters working
  memory carrying a slot value whose kind differs from the schema's
  declared slot type. There is **no implicit conversion**, and the
  invariant is a property of working memory rather than of any one
  entry point: it binds a host assertion, a rule-fired `emit`,
  a call's response fact, a published fact and a replayed
  inject-class atom identically. At a host call or in a replayed atom, a
  violation is `DS_ERR_SLOT_TYPE_MISMATCH` ([IDAT.4.6]); produced by a rule's
  activation, it is a `TypeError` (RARC.5.2.7).

  [NFCT.2.3] is this invariant stated at the host boundary, and
  [RLOW.1.4]'s compile-time obligation — *"every typed slot access must
  match the declared slot type"* — is defence in depth in front of it,
  not a substitute for it. A rule whose lowering produces a mistyped
  value must be refused at compile time **and** cannot reach working
  memory if it is not.
